value.rationale: A natural heavy-tail active-matter transport gap is resolved: at fixed positive chirality the path is Gaussian diffusive despite infinite renewal-time variance, and at exactly zero chirality the mean square is superlinear. The exact coefficient and noninteger alpha-dependent divergence measure experimentally meaningful sensitivity to weak angular rotation; the inference requires nontrivial stationary renewal correlation and singular integral analysis.
